title: Senior GNC Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) Engineer to lead the development of GNC solutions across our missile portfolio. You will drive the design, analysis, and validation of navigation, guidance, and control algorithms that enable precise, stable, and robust flight performance.

At Frankenburg, you will work alongside leading experts in technology and national defence, developing next-generation air defence missile systems for the free world. You will collaborate across disciplines, influence critical technical decisions, and mentor the next generation of engineers while helping bring advanced defence technologies from concept to flight.

Lead the design of navigation algorithms, sensor fusion architectures, and state estimation solutions.

Strong knowledge of guidance, navigation, control systems, state estimation, sensor fusion, and flight dynamics.

title: Structural Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Structural Engineer to support the development of next-generation defence systems through structural strength and fatigue analysis. In this role, you will perform simulations and engineering calculations using FEA and analytical methods, assess metal and composite structures, and provide analysis reports to support qualification and safety activities. Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will help optimise designs, evaluate test results, and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance defence products.

At Frankenburg, you will join an exceptional team of leading experts in technology and national defence, building next-generation defence missile systems for the free world. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your contribution shapes how we verify and demonstrate advanced defence systems. If you thrive on innovation and impact — we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Structural Analysis & Simulation
Perform structural strength, stiffness, and fatigue analyses of missile and launcher components using FEA and analytical methods to predict and validate structural performance.

- Qualification Support
Prepare analysis reports and strength documentation to support verification, qualification, and safety activities.

- Design Optimisation
Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to improve designs, evaluate trade-offs, and enhance structural performance throughout the product lifecycle.

- Testing & Validation

- Documentation & Traceability
Maintain clear and traceable records of structural analyses, engineering assumptions, requirements, and supporting documentation in line with company processes.

- Experience
Previous experience in structural analysis, fatigue calculations, and mechanical design of metallic and composite structures, preferably in aerospace, UAV or space applications.

Proficiency with FEA and 3D CAD software (ANSYS, Nastran, SolidWorks etc), structural and fatigue analysis, and a strong theoretical understanding of structural mechanics. Familiarity with defence industry standards (MIL-STD, STANAG) is a plus.
